---
title: Add Membership Card
description: >-
  Customize your digital membership card by selecting design orientations,
  configuring field display options, choosing custom card templates, and
  previewing the real-time layout.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Membership Card > Add Membership Card.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="303" height="172" style="width: 303px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Select membership card type.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="305" height="248" style="width: 305px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Insert card image and enter the title and description.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="391" height="254" style="width: 391px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
